# Chapter 5: Heather and Bobby

The babies arrived in the way that babies often arrived in that era: by cesarean section, under fluorescent lights, with a level of medical intervention that would have seemed extraordinary to any previous generation but that was simply the standard of care in 1975 and 1977. Heather came first, in the summer of 1975, and Bobby came two years later, in the winter of 1977, and together they transformed Bob's life in ways he had not known to anticipate.
